claims.claim: The Android manifest defines a standalone helper with package io.aios.node.bootstrap, a non-exported BOOT_COMPLETED receiver, a launcher setup Activity, and requests strictly RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED plus com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND with no network, storage, root, wake-lock, or shared-UID declarations.

BootReceiver performs exactly one fixed dispatch to com.termux.app.RunCommandService using action com.termux.RUN_COMMAND and the compile-time constant bootstrap path /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.aios-node/bootstrap/start-services.sh with startForegroundService on Android O+ and startService on older, with no caller-controlled path/arguments and no retry, loop, or scheduler mechanism.

MainActivity checks and requests com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND and displays bounded local setup and boot-dispatch diagnostics from SharedPreferences, exposing no command text editing, shell execution, or remote endpoints.

deploy/termux/bootstrap/start-services.sh uses native Termux shell, deterministically establishes PREFIX, SVDIR, and LOGDIR, writes bounded host-local boot marker data, and invokes service-daemon start exactly once without AIOS, Executor, Git, network, verification, retry, polling, wake-lock, or publication behavior.

The Android build definition uses platform Android APIs only with no external runtime dependencies, and .github/workflows/build-android-bootstrap.yml uses only GitHub-hosted runner ubuntu-latest, requires no secrets, builds only android/boot-bootstrap, uploads a debug APK qualification artifact, and contains no self-hosted runners or AIOS/executor invocations.

docs/N4-ANDROID-BOOTSTRAP.md comprehensively documents installation, one-time RUN_COMMAND permission grant, Termux allow-external-apps=true requirement and its security boundary, Xiaomi MIUI Autostart and battery requirements, bootstrap deployment path, artifact limitations, and the 12-point physical cold-boot reboot gate.

Standard-library repository tests in tests/test_android_bootstrap.py deterministically validate boundaries and reject generic command input, network permission, shared UID, AIOS/Executor invocations, retry/scheduler mechanisms, and self-hosted GitHub runner usage.

All 72 standard-library tests remain green, and the documentation and tests maintain that NODE-003B source completion does not mark N4 PASS, with physical cold-boot evidence remaining a separate mandatory qualification.
